description: Error kinds: tool error messages from the runner sessions grouped by tool and normalised pattern (ids, numbers, addresses removed) — e.g. «More than one mailbox» from six sessions is ONE kind with anzahl 6. Fields: werkzeug, muster, beispiel, erstmals_am, zuletzt_am, anzahl, status (neu|bekannt|geloest), uebergabe_id (handoff to the Problem-Sammler), optimierung_id. Newest first. Admins, planners and agents only.
name: list_fehlerarten
